name: Rats in the Old Mill
summary: A tiny placeholder adventure used by tests and as the default game until the starter arc exists: the miller's cellar is overrun, and something else lurks below.

chapters.name: The Old Mill
chapters.summary: Answer the notice, get into the mill, clear the cellar.

scenes.name: Millbrook Square
scenes.seed: A cobbled square around a mossy well. Market stalls are closing; the smell of bread drifts from the bakery. A notice board leans by the well.

variants.seed: Townsfolk nod at you as you pass. Word of the cleared cellar has spread.

pois.name: Notice board
pois.seed: Weathered notices, one fresh: 'RATS in the old mill. Reward. Ask Mayor Hobb.'

success.text: Under the rat notice is an older one, half torn: the miller's cellar key was 'lost' the night he vanished.

failure.text: Only the fresh notice about rats in the old mill is legible.

outcome.text: Mayor Hobb promises 10 gold pieces if the mill cellar is cleared, and hands over a spare key to the mill door.
Mayor Hobb counts out ten gold pieces with evident relief.

scenes.name: The Old Mill
scenes.seed: A creaking water wheel turns over a sluggish stream. The mill door is barred with a rusted padlock. Scratching sounds come from below.

exits.label: Unlock the door with the mayor's key

success.text: The rotten hasp splinters and the door swings in.

failure.text: The door shudders but holds. Your shoulder aches.

scenes.name: Mill Cellar
scenes.seed: A low cellar of damp flour sacks and gnawed grain barrels. Red eyes glint between the barrels.

onEnter.text: Two giant rats burst from the sacks!

pois.name: Miller's strongbox
pois.seed: A small iron-bound box wedged behind a barrel.

outcome.text: Inside the box you find what the miller left behind.

exits.label: Climb back up to the mill

npcs.name: Mayor Hobb
npcs.personality: Round, anxious, generous with promises and slow with coin.
secrets: He sold the miller the bad grain that drew the rats.

win.text: The last rat squeals and lies still.

lose.text: You wake up in the square, bitten and bruised; a farmer dragged you out.

flee.text: You scramble up the ladder and slam the hatch.

beats.text: Walking back into the square, you hear children cheering about the rats.

flags.description: Read the torn notice about the miller's key.
Got the mill key from the mayor.

endings.name: Rats cleared
endings.text: Millbrook's mill is safe again, for now.
